Elias learned that some lights exist only to carry messages ashore, and that even a small flame can outlast the storm that lit it.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一台尚未重启的机器。环卫工人的扫帚声划过空旷的街道，霓虹灯在潮湿的柏油路上投下模糊的光斑。写字楼的某扇窗仍亮着，像海面上最后一盏渔火。便利店里，关东煮的热气缓缓上升，值夜班的店员靠着收银台打盹。第一班公交车碾过井盖，发出沉闷的响声，惊起路边的流浪猫。天边泛起蟹壳青，豆浆铺的卷帘门哗啦一声拉开——城市翻了个身，即将醒来。", "w03": "• Imagine standing in a long line and wanting to know your position: you ask the person in front of you, and they ask the person in front of them.\n• Everyone does the same tiny job — ask the next person — until someone at the very front says \"I'm number 1!\"\n• Then the answers travel back down the line, each person adding one, until you finally know your own number: that's recursion — a big problem solved by smaller copies of itself."}
